title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels (borrowed by Peter Kafer) > Will Boswell's reel @ 7 1/2 ips; Transfer Info: Reel (Technics RS1506) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an epic acoustic‑first‑set show, highlighted by a soaring Not Fade Away.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this performance, calling it an “epic” show with an acoustic first set that’s a real treat and a second set packed with great moments. The recording is praised as sounding excellent (soundboard quality), with only faint tape‑hiss mentioned, making the music come through crystal clear. Standout moments include Not Fade Away and the emotive "To Lay Me Down" sequence.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and audio fidelity; the show is described as epic with highlighted songs, and the recording is noted as excellent.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear soundboard mix; one reviewer notes faint tape hiss but overall the audio is superb and very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic first set described as a treat, followed by a second set with strong material; overall pacing and song selection are praised.
